tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dmangs thab pa rnams kyis bya ba byed tshul gyi rnam gzhag bzhugs so// dmangs thab pa rnams nas nges dgos/ rgyal ba'i bka' las/ 'tsho ba'i zas la kun kyang 'du/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nged rang gis mtshon lto zan tha ma'i bar la bza' bca'i rnam gzhag mi phongs zhing tshim tsam zhig gi do dam thab kha le tshan gsum so so nas/ las bya rgyu'i tho re yod don bzhin 'dir yang / lto zan byings la ja thug skyogs 'gyed rgyag dgos rnams rim par bkod na/ lha bris pa/ shing bzo ba/ gnas bzo ba/ rdo bzo ba/ tshos khang ba/ bal dpon/ dpon ma/ bal khang pa byings/ rten bzhengs chen mo sogs byung skabs/ zangs gad/ gzi rgyag bsod snyoms pa'i rigs/ bzhes kong sogs gzigs 'bul ba'i rigs/ zhal brgyugs pa sogs dmigs bsal dgos gras a tsa ra bcas la 'gro dgos la bar thab nas ma 'thus pa byings lto zan lto thob yan la mi rer nyin ltar skyogs tshad bzhi re dang de phyin phogs par skyogs do re/ srod thug bskor dgos la gzim chung bskor dpon/ khang dpon/ chibs dpon/ rtsa gnyer/ mi dpon bzhi/ gnas bzo ba/ shing bzo ba/ lha bris pa/ par dpon/ dgu gzhung tshong pa rnams la skyogs re skor rtsis pa yin kyang / byang du seng ge sgo yan dang / lhor rgyal sgo yan du zla 'dril byung na ma gtogs gzhan bskor tshod med/ lto zan kha thog kyi ja/ tshogs chung sogs sha tshod dgos rnams rang 'jags 'bras sil dang / bro ma mar bzhu'i rigs mang dus bar shod kyi thab gnyis ka dang / nyung dus bar thab nas 'gan blangs byed rgyu dang / phur sgrub mdos chen skabs kyi thug pa rung khang nas ma song ba'i 'phros skyogs thob gang yod la skyogs re gtong rgyur mdor na g.yos 'du tshang ma dngos pos gang thon la lag len dang gtong tshod 'gad gtsang yong ba dang / dngos po skungs bsubs dang ma snyoms pa'i gleng brjod sna tshogs byas pa sogs mi 'thad pa'i rigs shar tshe rjes gnon tsha 'ded yong bas/

de bzhin du ma song ba dang / chu me shing gnyis da lta bzhin byed rgyu yin pas spangs blangs 'dzol med gal che/ gong gsal gyi ja mar tsha 'bras tshang ma/ thog mar gtan 'bebs yang dag bgyis pa'i thog dngos chas ma nyung ma mang pa dkrigs sbyar yong ba'i thob gzhi 'degs shor byed// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dmangs thab pa rnams kyis bya ba byed tshul gyi rnam gzhag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
